title: Silent Movement (General Skill, level 15)
body:
Syntax: silent movement [on|off] | perform silent movement [on|off]
All classes learn this skill at level 15; teacher practice is required first. This is a manually activated toggle, not a passive skill. Use silent movement to switch it on or off, or specify on/off explicitly. It stays ON without a time limit until switched off or you lack Stamina for a step. Activation costs 10 Stamina; cooldown 15 seconds. Suppresses normal walking arrival/departure messages to ordinary observers, but does not hide your body from look or scan. Sensory Detect notices your movements. Each successful step costs 2 extra Stamina; blocked exits cost nothing. If you cannot pay the extra cost, Silent Movement ends before travel messages are sent. Combine it with Camouflage for stealth. Other actions, speech and scripted events may still be noticed. Use aff or score to see whether it is ON.
